CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

5. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.

7. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

8. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

9. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

11. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)

   C. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
